name: Big and Blind Queenstown 2025

venue.name: Te Atamira
venue.address: Building 11, Dart House, Remarkables Park Town Centre 12 Hawthorne Drive, Frankton, Queenstown 9300
venue.details: Go forward through the main doors and turn right at the hallway. Marked room number seven on [this](https://www.teatamira.nz/visit#tours) map

information: Big and Blind Queenstown 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
